info.name: Nadara API v1
info.description:
Nadara clinic platform API.

Sign-in is split by portal: each front end has a door of its own, and the token it
hands back is stamped with that portal. A token minted at one door does not open
another, so "Login as PATIENT" then calling an admin route is a 403, not a 200.

Portals:
- Patient      POST /auth/login          (also /auth/register)
- Clinic       POST /clinic/auth/login   (doctor and secretary share it)
- Back office  POST /admin/auth/login

Shared, whichever door opened the session: /auth/me, /auth/logout,
/auth/logout-all and /auth/reset-password. Each portal has its own
forgot-password, and the reset link follows the account owner, not the endpoint.

Setup:
1. Run `php artisan serve` in the Backend folder.
2. Run `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` once to get the demo accounts.
3. Send the Login request for the portal you want. The token is saved into
   the {{token}} variable automatically, replacing whatever was there.

Demo accounts (password: `password`):
- admin@nadara.test      back office
- doctor@nadara.test     clinic
- secretary@nadara.test  clinic
- patient@nadara.test    patient

The Arabic demo set from DemoSeeder uses the password `nadara2026`:
- layla@nadara.test      clinic (doctor)
- sana@nadara.test       clinic (secretary)
- sara.demo@nadara.test  patient (and five more *.demo@nadara.test)

Folder 6 checks the split itself: the same correct password is rejected at the
wrong door, and it reads exactly like a wrong password so probing reveals nothing.

Folders 11 to 16 cover sprints 4 and 5: staff accounts, subscriptions and the audit log for the admin;
day to day clinic work under /staff; the doctor's own tools under /doctor; and in-app
notifications. Each folder says which login it needs. Ids are passed between requests
through collection variables, so run a folder top to bottom.

item.name: Book a time in the past (expect 422)

request.description: period: today | tomorrow | week (Saturday to Friday) | month. Days follow the clinic timezone, and results come oldest first. Cannot be combined with from/to.
from and to are Y-m-d dates in the clinic timezone, both inclusive. Either one may be sent alone.
Admin only: log in as an admin first. Any other role gets 422. Combines with period, from/to and status.

formdata.value: A red itchy patch on my forearm spreading for two weeks.

item.name: 11. Admin — doctors and secretaries (US-025)
item.description: Log in as ADMIN first. Staff never self-register: the admin opens every doctor and secretary account. There is no delete, accounts are deactivated instead.

request.description: The new doctor starts active, on a 14 day trial. Saves {{managed_doctor_id}} for the requests below.
Every field is optional. Sending `password` resets it and signs the doctor out everywhere.

exec: pm.test('tied to the doctor in the url', () => pm.expect(String(pm.response.json().data.doctor_id)).to.eql(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('managed_doctor_id'))));

request.description: Deactivating signs the secretary out everywhere. Send again to reactivate.
Deactivating hides the doctor from the catalog and signs them out. Existing appointments are not cancelled. Send again to reactivate.

item.name: Create doctor with a taken email (expect 422)

request.description: There is no delete route on purpose.

item.name: 12. Admin — subscriptions (US-028)
item.description: Log in as ADMIN first. No billing: money is collected outside the platform and the admin records it by moving the end date. A trial or subscription that runs out keeps working for a 7 day grace period, then the doctor drops out of the catalog.

request.description: status is one of: trial, active, grace, expired.
Uses {{managed_doctor_id}} from folder 11. The subscription covers the whole of that day.

item.name: 13. Admin — audit log
item.description: Log in as ADMIN first. Read only: every staff decision that moves money or access leaves an entry here.

request.description: Actions: payment.verified, payment.rejected, appointment.booked_by_phone, appointment.cancelled_by_clinic, appointment.duration_changed, appointment.completed, account.created, account.activated, account.deactivated, account.password_reset, subscription.extended.

item.name: 14. Clinic operations — /staff (US-013 to US-016, US-026)
item.description: Log in as DOCTOR or SECRETARY (they work on their own clinic), or as ADMIN (any clinic). Clinic staff must NOT send doctor_id. The admin must send doctor_id on phone booking, schedules and time off. Today's confirmed calendar is GET /appointments?period=today&status=approved (folder 8).

request.description: The review queue. Verify and reject stay on /payments/{id}/verify and /reject (folder 9).
Run "Doctor availability for a date" (folder 7) first so {{slot_start}} holds a free slot. The patient is found by phone, or an account is opened for a new number. As ADMIN add "doctor_id".
Moves the end time only. 409 if the new length runs into the next appointment.
200 once the appointment has started; 422 on start_at while it is still in the future. Completing is what brings the appointment into the doctor's income report.

exec: pm.test('paid, so a refund is owed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.refund_required).to.eql(true));

request.description: weekday: 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday. Times are clinic wall clock, HH:MM.
Send the whole shift. 409 with stranded_appointments if patients are booked into hours being removed.
Leave both times out for the whole day. 409 with stranded_appointments if patients are booked that day.

item.name: 15. Doctor tools — /doctor (US-020, US-027)
item.description: Log in as DOCTOR. The secretary shares the clinic portal but none of this folder: every request here is a 403 for them, and for the admin.

request.description: The whole catalog; offering is null for a service the doctor has not priced.
Creates or updates the doctor's terms. Appointments already booked keep their price and end time.
Run "Price a service" again afterwards to switch it back on.
Completed appointments and answered, paid consultations.
200 for the doctor's own confirmed or completed appointment; 422 on status otherwise; 403 for another doctor's. {{appointment_id}} comes from folder 8.
{{patient_id}} is saved by "List clinic patients" (folder 14). 404 for someone who never visited this doctor.

item.name: 16. Notifications
item.description: Any signed in user, and each sees only their own. Log in as PATIENT to see the ones raised by verifying or rejecting a receipt, a clinic cancellation, or a doctor's reply.

request.description: {{notification_id}} is saved by "My notifications". 404 for a notification that belongs to someone else.
